purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence and executed public requests.
name: Timișoara

queries.query: Timișoara official cadastral parcel GIS map API ANCPI geoportal parcels
queries.result: Search identified the official ANCPI Geoportal CP/CP_View MapServer and its Cadastral Parcel polygon layer; it also returned official Timișoara municipal GIS/cadastral pages.

queries.query: Timișoara cadastru parcele hartă GIS oficial imobile geoportal cadastral
queries.result: Search identified the official ANCPI cadastral parcel layer, the OCPI Timiș publicări cadastru general map page, and the Timișoara municipal GIS and cadastral-service pages.

officialSources.custodian: Agenția Națională de Cadastru și Publicitate Imobiliară (ANCPI)
officialSources.observation: Search metadata describes a public ArcGIS Feature Layer named Cadastral Parcel with polygon geometry, supported GeoJSON queries, EPSG:4258 service metadata, and safe technical fields including OBJECTID/IFCID/INSPIRE identifiers. No feature response was successfully retrieved in this environment.

officialSources.custodian: Municipiul Timișoara, Serviciul Evidența Patrimoniu și Cadastru
officialSources.observation: Official municipal page documents cadastral parcel identification, parcel plans, cadastral documentation, and liaison/data exchange with OCPI Timiș. It is evidence of a local cadastral custodian, not an anonymous citywide parcel API.
Official OCPI Timiș publication page lists cadastral-general map publications including Timișoara; the live page returned an unknown-status gateway failure when opened.

registryBasis: First-party ANCPI parcel-layer metadata and first-party Timișoara municipal cadastral-service documentation establish national and local cadastral custodians. Anonymous parcel geometry and stable native identity were not verified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: ANCPI national cadastral parcel layer and Timișoara municipal/OCPI cadastral responsibilities.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous parcel geometry response; citywide coverage, current dataset vintage, and Timișoara-specific layer filtering remain unverified.

uncertainty: A public layer may be available when the service is reachable, but the current access path, live schema, Timișoara coverage, native identity semantics, CRS response, update currency, and anonymous runtime behavior remain unresolved. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, personal, or unsafe fields were requested or retained.
